capabilities: prototype: verifier-oriented Ethernet IPv4 XDP packet parser with bounds checks
prototype: exact IPv4 source-address hash map with 4096-entry capacity
prototype: XDP_DROP only for explicit source-address map matches with action value 1
prototype: all unmatched, non-IPv4, VLAN-tagged, IPv6, malformed, and unsupported paths return XDP_PASS
prototype: offline versioned IPv4 ingress rule validation and deterministic map-update preview
prototype: BPF object compilation and ELF section checks in CI
not implemented: BPF object loader or verifier invocation
not implemented: map update execution, pinning, interface attach/detach, or live enforcement
not implemented: IPv6, VLAN parsing, CIDR, transport ports, counters, or rate limiting
negative_scope: fabricated or simulated live operational evidence
